title: OpenAI previews private safety checks for zero-retention API use
friendlyTitle: OpenAI plans safer checks without keeping customer text
summary: OpenAI says eligible API customers can continue using Zero Data Retention while a forthcoming Private Safety Processing system looks for risk patterns across interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying prompts and responses. The system is in early testing, with a technical white paper and rollout planned for September.
friendlySummary: OpenAI is testing a system that can spot risky patterns while keeping eligible customers’ prompts and replies private from its staff.
whyItMatters: If the design performs as described, organizations handling sensitive data may gain broader agent safety monitoring without surrendering content access; buyers should wait for the technical details and confirm eligibility and exceptions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could help businesses use advanced AI with stronger privacy, but the full technical details are not available yet.
